answer_text:
Let

\[
F(x)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \binom{2n}{n}x^n.
\]

A standard generating function is

\[
F(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-4x}}, \qquad |x|<\frac14.
\]

Differentiate term-by-term:

\[
F'(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}x^{n-1}.
\]

Multiplying by \(x\),

\[
xF'(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}x^n.
\]

Since

\[
F'(x)=2(1-4x)^{-3/2},
\]

we get

\[
xF'(x)=\frac{2x}{(1-4x)^{3/2}}.
\]

Our sum has an extra factor of \(2\), so

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{2n}{8^n}\binom{2n}{n}
=
2\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n\binom{2n}{n}\left(\frac18\right)^n
=
2\left.\frac{2x}{(1-4x)^{3/2}}\right|_{x=1/8}.
\]

Thus

\[
2\cdot \frac{2(1/8)}{(1-4/8)^{3/2}}
=
\frac{1/2}{(1/2)^{3/2}}
=
\frac12 \cdot 2^{3/2}
=
\sqrt{2}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\sqrt{2}}
\]
